overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed the district's new instructional vision and 2024 MCAS performance, approved a Title IX policy, and requested an administrative report on high school bathroom conditions. The committee also authorized temporary compensation for the municipal DEI Director while referring an ongoing shared-support proposal to subcommittee.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, capital purchases, a $1,000 Model UN grant, field trips, and meeting minutes, with the October 28 minutes severed and approved as amended.

items.title: Superintendent Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on staff professional development, student athletic and band achievements, the upcoming Krystle Campbell Memorial Garden dedication, and statewide MSBA school survey visits.

items.title: Automotive Vehicle Donation
items.summary: Approved the donation of a 2011 Hyundai Santa Fe valued at approximately $1,000 for use by the high school automotive program.

items.title: District Instructional Vision
items.summary: Administrators presented the district's core instructional vision framework centered on equity, high-quality instruction, deeper engagement, data-informed practices, and belonging.

items.title: 2024 MCAS and Accountability Presentation
items.summary: Curriculum directors reviewed 2024 MCAS achievement and student growth data across civics, English language arts, mathematics, and science, highlighting district growth trends and targeted intervention plans.

items.title: Policy ACGB: Title IX Sexual Discrimination Grievance Procedure
items.summary: Approved Policy ACGB establishing Title IX sexual discrimination grievance procedures after voting to waive the reading.

items.title: Resolution 2024-39: Medford High School Bathroom Conditions
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the administration to submit a report on December 2, 2024, detailing bathroom conditions, staffing constraints, and recommendations to increase bathroom access at Medford High School.

items.title: Resolution 2024-40: City DEI Director Support and Compensation
items.summary: Approved temporary compensation of $3,750 for City DEI Director Frances Nwajeh for services provided from July 1 through December 31, 2024, and referred the broader support agreement to the DEI Subcommittee for review by December 16, 2024.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence in memory of former kindergarten teacher Gloria M. Carew and former crossing guard Joseph S. Tarantino.
